value.rationale: The theorem resolves the physically motivated regime-of-validity question at rare stationary displacements for a frequently reset Brownian system. Its exact global inequality, unusually delayed sixth-order error, and strongly different distant rates quantify a failure that central Gaussian convergence and even exact variance agreement cannot diagnose; the gap gives a structural constraint on using the approximation to estimate rare events.
